items.title: Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering
items.title_zh: Micius-Flash：面向工程领域的轻量级智能体智能
items.summary: Micius-Flash is a 27-billion-parameter engineering model with native multimodal input, deep reasoning and a 256K-token context window, trained through a knowledge-tree-driven data flywheel and multi-teacher on-policy distillation. The authors report 64.2% average on hardware code benchmarks, 15.0 points above a same-size baseline, and 62.4% on a semiconductor agent benchmark, 17.2 points higher, and release the model as open source.

items.title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
items.title_zh: CompressionBench：你的编码智能体如何压缩 LLM？
items.summary: CompressionBench frames LLM compression as a terminal task in which a coding agent receives a checkpoint, storage limit, inference environment and time budget, then produces compressed weights and executable inference code. Across six agents and six model-size settings, 29 of 36 submissions pass verification, and the lowest-perplexity designs average a 3.4% perplexity increase over BF16 with 77.33% downstream accuracy versus 79.56% for BF16.

items.title: Authorization Propagation in Agent2Agent Systems: An Experimental Security Evaluation of Multi-Hop Delegation
items.title_zh: Agent2Agent 系统中的授权传播：多跳委托的实验性安全评估
items.summary: The paper evaluates a layered downstream-verification design for delegated Agent2Agent workflows in a synthetic four-party healthcare reimbursement scenario, separating caller context, transitive authorization evidence, per-hop Ed25519 authentication and replay state. It reports 14 of 15 adversarial conditions rejected, but an isolated delegation-path test exposes the absence of semantic authority attenuation, and a holder of the shared HMAC key can alter the represented authority.

items.title: Pixie: A Context-Aware Multi-Agent Multi-Modal Large Language Models (LLM) Architecture for Digital Marketing
items.title_zh: Pixie：面向数字营销的上下文感知多智能体多模态 LLM 架构
items.summary: Pixie is a context-aware multi-agent LLM architecture for digital marketing that pairs a primary orchestration agent with task-specific and reconciliation/reviewer agents, combining zero-shot and few-shot prompting with marketing data and expert guidelines. The authors evaluate single-agent through multi-agent workflows with trained marketing experts and output-variance measurements, reporting improved decision quality and operational efficiency.

items.title: Adapting LLM Judges to Observed Human Annotation Policy through Soft Prompt Tuning
items.title_zh: 通过软提示调优使 LLM 评审器适配观察到的人工标注策略
items.summary: The paper studies whether soft prompt tuning can align lightweight open-source LLM judges more closely with human annotation policy, training prompts on FairBotBench and evaluating bias, toxicity and personalization. It reports that hybrid textual-plus-learned prompts consistently improve agreement over untuned baselines, with Qwen 3.5 9B surpassing both hosted reference judges on all three dimensions.

items.title: Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI
items.title_zh: 适配的进程：AI 中的达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体主导演化
items.summary: The paper develops a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian and agent-directed evolution after environmental change, where agents generate and evaluate behavioral variants and choose how extensively to search. It argues that more search accelerates adaptation, but that misspecified evaluation targets can make additional search converge faster toward the wrong behavior, a risk for recursive self-improvement.

items.title: SD-LoRA: Training-Time Structural Distillation into LoRA for Few-Shot Vision-Language Adaptation
items.title_zh: SD-LoRA：面向少样本视觉语言适配的训练时结构蒸馏到 LoRA
items.summary: SD-LoRA uses a heterogeneous graph teacher over high-resolution ViT tokens during training only, distilling patch-patch, global-local and visual-text structure into a lightweight CLIP-LoRA backbone. Across 11 few-shot benchmarks it improves over a strong CLIP-LoRA baseline by 2.0-3.0 percentage points in the 4/8/16-shot settings without extra graph computation at inference.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.title_zh: claude-mem：为每个 Agent 提供跨会话持久上下文
items.summary: claude-mem is a TypeScript project that captures an agent's session activity, compresses it with AI and injects relevant context into future sessions, with support for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and OpenCode among others.

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
items.title_zh: agent-desktop：面向 AI 智能体的计算机操作 CLI
items.summary: Vercel Labs' agent-desktop is a Rust-based command-line tool for computer use by AI agents.
